packages.name: git-commit-wizard
packages.description: Interactive git commit message wizard with conventional commits support
packages.author: MattMakes

files.commands/git-commit-wizard.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# Git commit wizard
echo 'Git Commit Wizard'
echo 'Select commit type:'
select type in feat fix docs style refactor test chore; do
  echo "Type: $type"
  read -p 'Scope (optional): ' scope
  read -p 'Short description: ' desc
  read -p 'Long description (optional): ' long
  
  if [ -n "$scope" ]; then
    msg="$type($scope): $desc"
  else
    msg="$type: $desc"
  fi
  
  if [ -n "$long" ]; then
    git commit -m "$msg" -m "$long"
  else
    git commit -m "$msg"
  fi
  break
done

packages.name: pre-commit-linter
packages.description: Pre-commit hook that runs linters and formatters
packages.author: MattMakes

files.hooks/pre-commit:
#!/bin/bash
# Pre-commit hook for linting and formatting

echo "Running pre-commit checks..."

# Run linters based on file types
if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q '\.js$\|\.ts$'; then
  echo "Linting JavaScript/TypeScript files..."
  # Add your linter command here
  # Example: npx eslint $(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.js$\|\.ts$')
fi

if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q '\.py$'; then
  echo "Linting Python files..."
  # Add your linter command here
  # Example: pylint $(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.py$')
fi

echo "Pre-commit checks passed!"
exit 0
